description: Full-text search against Siigo's curated content for a country. Returns matching pages, posts, and resources. Use this when the user mentions a topic you don't have a more specific tool for. Example call: {"country": "COL", "query": "facturacion electronica"}. Note: the COL shell has search disabled until its cached search service ships, so it currently returns an empty items array — prefer get_articles or get_compliance_info meanwhile.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. Only countries listed in DependencyInjection:ProfileInjector:Actives are served. Examples: COL, MEX, ECU.

query.description: Free-text query against Siigo's WordPress content. Between 2 and 200 chars, no angle brackets. Examples: facturacion electronica, nomina, plan emprendedor.

name: search
